extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors/users attempting to create a new article
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for users who find a missing Wikipedia page title and want to create or recover an article (procedural requirements, checks to perform before creating, and troubleshooting steps).

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmation requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for alternative titles or spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Please search for "SNL book" in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, verify whether the topic already exists under a different title or spelling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check for existing incoming links
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the 'What links here' tool to see whether other pages reference the intended title (which may indicate redirects or related pages).

rubrics_metrics.name: Case sensitivity and redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the proper title differs only by capitalization or minor variation, create a redirect rather than a duplicate article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recent-creation visibility delay
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wait a few minutes or try the purge function to refresh the database/view.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deleted-page troubleshooting
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the deletion log to learn reasons for deletion and whether recreation is appropriate or requires discussion.
